Dough Intent Coverage — Caught.

Story: SEED-358#reconstruct-codex-and-claude-code-usage-history. Checked revision: 29cfcb6758eda2c38c448af17b9a7848829c90ac. Source at that revision: .planning/seeds/SEED-358-dashboard-launch-history.md#reconstruct-codex-and-claude-code-usage-history; completed plan: .planning/slice-plans/624-reconstruct-codex-and-claude-code-usage-history/PLAN.md.

Selected promise: repeated progressive and terminal snapshots for one Claude API message retain their raw evidence and settle one terminal output measurement rather than treating progress as competing final usage. The maintained case uses one message, progressive outputs3/8 with null stops, and terminal output690 with tool_use between them.

One deliberate scratch fault in dashboard/server/usageMeasurements.ts, measurementsForCounter (line44): replaced `return measurements.filter((item) => !isProgressive(item));` with `return measurements;`. Fixtures and assertions were unchanged. The isolated scratch worktree /tmp/seed358-intent-coverage and branch codex/intent-coverage-seed358 started clean at the checked revision; they published nothing.

Focused command, identical for baseline, fault and restoration:

```sh
caffeinate -s -i env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES /usr/bin/time -p node node_modules/playwright/cli.js test --config dashboard/backend.playwright.config.ts dashboard/backend-tests/usage-history/claude-completion.spec.ts --grep 'counts explicit terminal output once' --workers=1
```

Baseline passed (exit0). With the fault, the maintained case failed (exit1) at claude-completion.spec.ts:93: its persisted observation.tokens assertion expected output690 and reasoningOutput20 but received null/null. This is the intended accounting failure, not an unrelated setup or output-reporter failure.

Independent actual-CLI witness used the same native row shape, ordering, launch reference and counters in a separate isolated HOME, then read persisted records in a new process. Baseline and restored reads showed one msg-one observation, output690, reasoningOutput20, measured coverage, raw outputs[3,690,8], stop reasons[null,tool_use,null], and null task outcome. Under the fault, the same path produced one observation with outputnull/reasoningOutputnull, partial coverage and contradictory-measurements; the raw facts and input/cache counters remained unchanged. This independently establishes the wrong behavior exercised and caught by the maintained assertion.

Restoration copied the exact original module bytes in a finally block. The same focused command then passed (exit0); the independent witness again read690/20. Scratch Git HEAD and pre-probe status matched, the module hash matched its saved original, and cleanup verified a clean checkout before safely removing the scratch worktree and branch. No product test, fixture, native source, live usage store, root checkout or CI observer was changed. Evidence: /tmp/seed358-intent-evidence contains baseline/fault/restored logs, all three witness JSON results, original source, restoration receipt and fault trace/error context. Node24.21.0; AC power,65% memory free,148GiB disk available; one worker under the maintained caffeinate guard. No setup or waiting problem occurred.

Next proof action: retain the maintained terminal-output assertion. This probe requires no additional proof change and claims protection only for this exercised progressive/terminal path, not the entire story.

Prior disposition: this is the already-delivered slice10 terminal-measurement behavior and its maintained proof. The deliberate scratch fault is not evidence of an actual delivered defect and creates no new repair decision.
